authority: User clarifications and eight supplied screenshots, 2026-10-23. User subsequently confirmed the guild settlement system was in progress and needs to be designed and implemented.
development_mode: New design and implementation guided by the prototypes. Do not block guild implementation waiting for a complete original version. Use configurable rules and identify chosen reconstruction defaults.
confirmed_scope: Inventory, player money and currencies are multiplayer gameplay state requiring correct server authority and replication.
The game includes building inside a guild session, using crafting items/materials, together with vendors and farming.
The user identifies the supplied world/map reference as the main map. Do not assume the currently configured Tutorial map is the intended main world.
Guild settlement gameplay and party formation are distinct systems; preserve their separate ownership and membership semantics.
screenshot_evidence: Settlement UI tabs: Buildings, Villagers, Guild Tech, Bank, Members and Reputation.
Mine detail UI shows building level, performance, occupied villagers, maximum level, income, tax, upkeep and generated items. Displayed example values are not confirmed balance constants.
Build widget hierarchy lists Farm, Watch Tower, Barracks, Market, Bank, BlackSmith, Tavern, Portal, GuildHall, Lumberjack, Mine, Tailor, Wall and Academy.
Farm references include unplanted ground and grown crops with an interaction prompt.
Guild tech UI includes Base, Members, Crafting and Reputation rows.
A screenshot identifies a guild widget parent displayed as DT Guild Widget. DT-prefixed classes can belong to intended guild gameplay; do not classify all DT code as disposable template code.
Other visible historical asset names include BP_MasterBuilding, BP_Farm, BP_TerritoryActor, WBP_GuildMenu, WBP_GuildTech, WBP_MemberSlot and WBP_NPCSlot.
The world-map artwork screenshot is a geographic reference. It does not establish which local Unreal map package contains the implemented world.
Main menu reference includes Tutorial, Host Game, Join Game, Settings, Load Game and Quit Game.
restoration_requirements: Keep personal inventory/currency separate from guild-owned bank/resources, and validate membership and permissions for guild mutations on the server.
Buying and selling validate stock, quantities, capacity and authoritative currency balances, with item/currency changes committed together.
Crafting and construction validate recipes, required materials, eligibility, placement and permissions before consuming resources and producing an item or building.
Concurrent construction, crafting, purchases, harvests and bank transfers must preserve inventory and currency totals and avoid duplicate outputs.
Guild buildings, placement, upgrade levels, assigned villagers and production state replicate to their intended viewers and persist for their intended world/session lifetime.
Farming interaction, growth, harvesting and output ownership use server-owned state. Define configurable growth durations and harvest output rules for the new system.
Design guild technology, membership, bank, reputation and building production rules as configurable new gameplay data; distinguish proposed defaults from confirmed user requirements.
Identify and inspect the actual main-world map, its game mode, guild territory/session ownership and travel flow before changing default gameplay wiring.
unverified_rules: Currency denominations, conversion rates, prices and limits
Guild bank ownership, member roles and spending/withdrawal permissions
Recipe and construction costs, placement restrictions, upgrades and demolition refunds
Farming growth timers, offline progression and harvest ownership
Production schedules, taxes, upkeep, villager effects and reputation/technology formulas
Whether guild sessions are separate instances and how they persist across host disconnects or server restarts
Exact local package path corresponding to the pictured main world
local_snapshot_findings: The inspected source project contains vendor/crafting/house UI, reconstructed gold/bronze items and reconstructed Farm/Tavern/TownHall Blueprints.

RPGBuilding is an empty native actor shell. The former Craft implementation added output without consuming ingredients; the reconstructed native implementation now validates configured recipes and commits costs/output atomically, with its regression test passing. UI integration is pending.

The photographed WBP_GuildMenu, WBP_GuildTech, BP_TerritoryActor and BP_MasterBuilding assets were not found by filename in the inspected source snapshot. A corresponding guild/territory/master-building search in the other local DuTraveller project also returned no matches.
Only MainMenu and Tutorial are under Content/Levels in the source snapshot; remaining map packages are art/sample maps. The pictured main world has not been identified among them.
status: Guild settlement is an authorized new implementation based on the user's in-progress prototypes. Native functionality, UI, replication and persistence must be built and tested; screenshot values remain examples rather than fixed balance rules.
